sources.snippet: Overview Relevant source files Purpose and Scope This document provides a comprehensive introduction to PromptGuard, an AI prompt injection defense system designed to protect LLM-powered agents and applications from manipulation attacks. This overview covers the system's purpose, key features, operational modes, and high-level architecture.
